privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: {brand} lets you build a gift that someone opens from a QR code. This page explains what we store to make that work.
privacy.s1Text: The content you add to a gift: names, texts, photos, voice notes, the trivia question and the surprise. Photos are converted and stripped of their metadata (including location) before they are stored. We do not create accounts.
privacy.s2Text: Payments are handled by Stripe. We never see your card details. Stripe gives us the result of the payment and the email you enter at checkout. We keep that email with your gift for two things only: the receipt Stripe sends you, and a single email one year after the gift was published, inviting you to see it again. It is deleted with the gift.
privacy.s3Text: Anyone who has the gift's link or QR code. Gift pages are not listed anywhere and search engines are told not to index them. The private edit link is stored only in your browser: keep it safe, because it is the only way to edit or delete the gift.
privacy.s4Title: Deleting a gift, and how long we keep it
privacy.s4Text: You can delete a gift at any time from the editor: its texts, photos and voice notes are removed from our systems for good. A draft that is never published is deleted after {draftDays} days. A free gift is deleted {freeMonths, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} after it was published. A paid gift is kept until you delete it. Once published, a gift can be corrected for {graceHours} hours; after that it can only be deleted.
privacy.s5Text: We do not use advertising or analytics cookies. Your browser stores your language preference and the edit links of your gifts.
privacy.s6Text: For any question about your data, write to the address shown on the legal notice of this site.
